name: vitalis
description: Wellness companion: habit tracking, weekly insights and an AI chat assistant.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix services/gateway && npm install --prefix services/auth-service && npm install --prefix services/habits-service && npm install --prefix services/chat-service
